title: Join the TMU AIMLA Team
content: Students interested in joining TMU AIMLA can submit the club's team registration form. Joining allows students to add their name to the AIMLA roster, receive updates about openings, and participate in projects, workshops, and events.

metadata.source: Official TMU AIMLA website Join component

title: Collaborate with TMU AIMLA
content: Clubs, companies, and community organizations can submit TMU AIMLA's collaboration form to propose a partnership. AIMLA collaborates on hack nights, panels, sponsorships, and custom programming tailored to the partner's goals.

metadata.source: Official TMU AIMLA website Join component

title: Contact TMU AIMLA by Email
content: Questions for TMU AIMLA can be sent to aimla.tmu@gmail.com.

metadata.source: Official TMU AIMLA website Join component

title: TMU AIMLA Social Media and Community Links
content: TMU AIMLA can be followed on Instagram and LinkedIn. Students can also join the TMU AIMLA Discord community.

metadata.source: Official TMU AIMLA website Join component
